reason: A web interface skin that applies a blue-whale color theme to DeepSeek branding and primary accents while preserving the built-in appearance modes and layout.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek 网页界面应用蓝鲸配色主题，调整品牌标识和主要操作元素的颜色，并保留内置明暗外观设置。
summaries.en: Applies a blue-whale color theme to the DeepSeek web interface’s branding and primary accents while preserving its built-in light and dark appearance settings.

capabilities: Changes DeepSeek web interface colors and branding accents
Supports light and dark appearance modes through the built-in setting
